Ferry services across 𝟭𝟲 𝗿𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗲𝘀 on the Hooghly have been suspended indefinitely since Wednesday afternoon after workers of the Hooghly River Water Transport Cooperative Society alleged 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗺𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗵𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝘂𝗻𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘄𝗮𝗴𝗲𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗻𝗼 𝗣𝘂𝗷𝗮 𝗯𝗼𝗻𝘂𝘀. Passengers were left stranded at ferry ghats.

The disruption affects key connections including 𝗛𝗼𝘄𝗿𝗮𝗵–𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗽𝗮𝗹, 𝗔𝗵𝗶𝗿𝗶𝘁𝗼𝗹𝗮, 𝗦𝗵𝗼𝘃𝗮𝗯𝗮𝘇𝗮𝗿 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗕𝗮𝗴𝗵𝗯𝗮𝘇𝗮𝗿. Reports estimate around 𝟭𝟱,𝟬𝟬𝟬 𝗽𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗱𝗮𝗶𝗹𝘆 use these routes. With Puja approaching, an urgent resolution is needed to restore this vital river transport network.
